## Using FUNDING.yml

This document demonstrates how to use a `FUNDING.yml` file to configure the `support-this` extension in Quarto. 
The extension will read the funding information from the `FUNDING.yml` file located in the same directory
as this document. We have specified the `use_funding_yml: true` option in the extension configuration to
enable this feature.

```yaml
title: "Funding YAML Example"
format: html
extensions:
    support-this:
        heading: "Support My Work (Based on FUNDING.yml)"
        use_funding_yml: true
```

### FUNDING.yml Structure

The `FUNDING.yml` file can include multiple platforms and custom links, allowing you to easily manage your
funding options in one place. For more details on the format of the `FUNDING.yml` file, refer to the 
[GitHub documentation on funding files](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/displaying-a-sponsor-button-in-your-repository).

Here is the content of the `FUNDING.yml` file used in this example:

```yaml
github: [coatless, octocat]
patreon: username
custom: ["https://paypal.me/username", thecoatlessprofessor.com]
```

### Where the file is found

support-this uses the first of these it finds:

1. `FUNDING.yml` or `.github/FUNDING.yml` next to the document, as on this page.
2. The same at the root of the Quarto project.
3. The same at the root of the git repository. This is where GitHub keeps the file, so a project in a `docs/` folder can reuse the repository's `.github/FUNDING.yml`.

Keys without a value, as in GitHub's default template, are skipped, and keys for platforms support-this doesn't know are ignored.

### Combining with `platforms`

`FUNDING.yml` is the base. Platforms listed under `platforms` are added to it, and a platform set in both places uses the document's accounts. For example, with the `FUNDING.yml` above, this configuration keeps the GitHub and Patreon links but replaces the two custom links with one:

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    use_funding_yml: true
    platforms:
      custom: "https://thecoatlessprofessor.com"
```
